subject: Renewal readiness: CloudLeap Q4 commitment and hygiene checklist
messages:
From: Alicia Barnes <alicia@cloudleap.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: sam.crawford@cloudleap.com
Date: Thu, 05 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning for CloudLeap (Q4)

Hi Vanessa,

Hope you’re well — Sam and I are starting to pull together the Q4 renewal plan for CloudLeap. We want to get ahead of any surprises (usage dips, feature adoption lags) and make sure Finance has a clean commit to include in the forecast. Can we schedule a short call to review the current commit probability and any hygiene items you need from us?

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm invoice cadence and any pending credits or adjustments.
- Share the latest usage trend and a recommended renewal tier.
- Any items we should surface to our CFO for sign-off.

Thanks — available next week most afternoons PT.

Best,
Alicia Barnes
Director, Customer Success
CloudLeap Inc.

Attachments: usage-trends-q2.pdf (summary of API calls, token consumption)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Barnes <alicia@cloudleap.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 06 Aug 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning for CloudLeap (Q4)

Thanks Alicia — great to hear you’re getting this organized. I can take the lead on the renewal hygiene check. Draft agenda below; propose 30 minutes next Wednesday 8/11 at 10:00am PT unless you prefer another slot.

Draft agenda (30m):
1) Current commitment status & Finance-ready ARR number (Marissa)
2) Usage trend summary + adoption flags (Vanessa)
3) Risk signals: support tickets, latency incidents, feature gaps (Rishi)
4) Surface any commercial requests (discounts, credits) + timeline to sign (Customer)

Pre-reads I’ll send: current commit sheet and a short usage trend PDF. For the call to be finance-ready, please confirm the executive approver (CFO/Head of Ops) who will finalize the signature. If you can get that on the invite, that speeds things up.

Attachments: 20270810-cloudleap-usage-trends-q2.pdf (sent)

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: CloudLeap commit update and staging notes

Vanessa — I reviewed the renewal likelihood and updated the commit sheet. Key points:
- Current ARR baseline: $372,000
- Recommended finance-ready commit: $355,000 (conservative, 95% payment terms)
- Probability buckets: moved $60k from "commit" to "late-commit" due to recent churn signal in usage.

I attached the commit sheet (rows highlighted) and added a short notes column with the main drivers (usage drop in July, two support tickets flagged, no feature adoption for advanced caching).

Action items for call:
- Ask CloudLeap for exec approver and confirm timing for DocuSign.
- Propose a one-time onboarding credit instead of a price reduction (if they press on price).
- Flag for Finance: potential 30-day slip of $60k if no signature by 8/31.

Attachments: 20270812-clp-commit-sheet.xlsx (commit probabilities, highlighted rows)

Marissa
Senior Revenue Operations Analyst

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Barnes <alicia@cloudleap.com>, Sam Crawford <sam.crawford@cloudleap.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal planning for CloudLeap (Q4) — hygiene checklist and next steps

Alicia / Sam — thanks for the sync earlier and for confirming Sam as the executive approver. Quick summary and next steps below so Finance can bake this into the forecast this week: 

Summary (short):
- Finance-ready commitment: $355,000 ARR (Marissa) — conservative figure accounting for usage variation.
- At-risk amount: $60,000 (moved to late-commit bucket; flagged due to drop in July usage).
- Recommended commercial path: onboarding credit (one-time) + targeted adoption play for advanced caching to recover usage.

Ask of CloudLeap (by EOD Tue 8/17):
- Confirm acceptance of the $355k figure and DocuSign path (I’ve attached the DocuSign link below).
- Confirm billing cadence (annual vs quarterly) and any internal PO requirements.
- Approver signature (Sam) or alternate approver name/email.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/instance/12345
Attachments included: 20270810-cloudleap-usage-trends-q2.pdf, 20270812-clp-commit-sheet.xlsx

Quoted for context:
> On Tue, 10 Aug 2027 at 14:20, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Vanessa — I reviewed the renewal likelihood and updated the commit sheet. Key points:
> - Current ARR baseline: $372,000
> - Recommended finance-ready commit: $355,000 (conservative, 95% payment terms)
> - Probability buckets: moved $60k from "commit" to "late-commit" due to recent churn signal in usage.

If I don’t hear back by EOD Tue we’ll move the $60k to the slip line in the forecast and Finance will exclude it from this quarter’s committed number. If helpful, Rishi can run a quick adoption outreach play to the technical contacts early next week.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
